verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales ships many AI features (Copilot, predictive scoring, agents), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes a training opt-out, data-use policy, or AI privacy control. Absent evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
